_comment: Declarative cmux layout for a Claude-only fleet. Template — spawn_claude_fleet.py substitutes __FEATURE__ (fleet slug, dash-case, safe anywhere), __CWD__ (absolute target path, escaped for INSIDE the double-quoted boot prompts and wrapped in visible \" quotes there, so spaces and apostrophes survive) and __ASSETS__ (absolute path to the directory holding these files, shell-quoted as a bare word) before passing this to `cmux workspace create --layout`. CONTEXT RULE: __CWD__ may only appear inside the double-quoted boot prompts; __ASSETS__ only in bare argument positions. Swapping them produces a pane command the shell cannot parse. Manager (Fable) occupies the left half; worker-1..4 (Opus) fill a 2x2 on the right. Each pane's command auto-launches its Claude Code agent on creation, so the whole fleet boots at once — no per-pane driving. The `name` field is the join key: the manager maps names to live surface refs via `cmux tree --workspace <ws> --json`, so no roster file is ever needed. Each pane command is prefixed with FLEET_ROLE=<role>: identity that survives /clear and compaction (the boot prompt does not). The fleet_context_hook.py SessionStart hook reads it to re-anchor the agent. NOTE: list-pane-surfaces is NOT usable for this — it is pane-scoped (defaults to the focused pane), so it cannot enumerate sibling panes.

surfaces.name: manager
surfaces.command: FLEET_ROLE=manager claude --model fable --dangerously-skip-permissions --append-system-prompt-file __ASSETS__/fleet-manager.md "You are the MANAGER of fleet __FEATURE__. Your workers are the sibling panes in this window: worker-1, worker-2, worker-3, worker-4. Find their surface refs by running: cmux identify --json (to get your workspace ref), then cmux tree --workspace <ws> --json (to map each layout name to its live surface ref). Your shared bus is the directory .team/__FEATURE__/ under \"__CWD__\" (also your current working directory). Wait for the human to hand you a task, then decompose and dispatch."

surfaces.name: worker-1
surfaces.command: FLEET_ROLE=worker-1 claude --model opus --effort max --dangerously-skip-permissions --append-system-prompt-file __ASSETS__/fleet-worker.md "You are worker-1 on fleet __FEATURE__. Your shared bus is the directory .team/__FEATURE__/ under \"__CWD__\"; your files there are worker-1.md and worker-1.done. Reply with one line: ready: worker-1  then wait for the manager to assign work."
